description: Use this when the person asks about one font: its weights and styles, its license, the languages it covers, or what to pair it with. Its measures help pair it: match x-heights for faces that meet on a line, and pick a partner that differs clearly in contrast or classification. id is a family's id, its name in lowercase with hyphens ("lora", "space-mono"). Not for the CSS that loads a font on a page. Answers one family: its name, page link, category, designer, license, every style it has, the languages it fully covers, its measured x-height, width and stroke contrast with its classification, the families that pair with it and the ones that look like it.

id.description: a family id from search_fonts ("lora"), or its name
